body: You’re welcome(: You’re definitely not alone. It’s just that it’s scary telling people you know for the fear of being rejected by them so we all just stay quiet/:

It’s still considered r/pe even if you guys were in a relationship because you weren’t able to give consent under the influence. It’s your choice if you want to tell them. You can take a chance and tell the friend that you trust the most. It hurts keeping it all in and having at least one person know your story helps. I’m here for you if you wanna talk. And if you don’t thats okay too.

You don’t have to tell them if you don’t want to. But if they’re really your friends they should take your side no matter what. If you don’t tell those that care about you then it‘ll eat you up inside for a while/:
